name: SwitchToIframeNode
label: Switch To Iframe
description: Switches the browser context to a specified iframe using the provided locator type and value (e.g., ID, Name, XPath, or CSS Selector).
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Browser Instance
fields.description: The active IWebDriver instance representing the browser.

fields.name: IframeLocatorType
fields.label: Iframe Locator Type
fields.description: The type of locator used to identify the iframe. Supported values: Id, Name, XPath, Css, or Index.

selectOptions.label: Index
selectOptions.description: Locate element by its zero-based index among matched elements.

fields.name: IframeLocatorValue
fields.label: Iframe Locator Value
fields.description: The value corresponding to the locator type (e.g., the iframe's ID, name, XPath expression, CSS selector, or zero-based index).

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout (Seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the iframe to become available before timing out.

fields.name: Switched
fields.label: Switched
fields.description: Indicates whether the switch to the iframe was successful (true) or failed (false).
